Grammar · Verb forms

Irregular Verbs

Grouped by pattern, so you remember them by sound and shape. Study the groups, then practice with the games.

Simple Past

Finished action at a specific time. Uses the 2nd form.
I wrote the report yesterday.

Present Perfect

Connects past and present. have / has + 3rd form.
I have written three reports this week.
Base = infinitive Past = Simple Past Participle = Present Perfect (have + …) 🔊 Tap a word to hear it · ▶ plays all three 🇧🇷 Hover or tap a base verb to see what it means
